cases.question: How do I make Le Tourin garlic soup?

response.answer: To make Le Tourin garlic soup, brown the chopped garlic (10 to 12 cloves) in the olive oil in a frying pan, add the flour and cook a few minutes to remove the floury taste, then gradually stir in the water and cook for 10 minutes. Beat the egg white, temper it with a ladleful of soup and stir it back into the pot. Combine the egg yolk, pepper and vinegar, temper the yolks with a ladleful of soup, then remove the soup from the heat, stir in the yolk mixture and season with salt. Place thin slices of bread in each bowl, pour the soup on top and serve hot. The recipe makes 2 servings and takes 30 minutes; you can optionally use an equal mixture of chopped onions and garlic. cases.question: What's the method for pasta carbonara?

response.answer: Pasta carbonara is made from the Carbonara Pasta recipe. Put the pasta on to cook. Crack the eggs and separate the yolks into a large bowl, keeping the whites for another use. Fry the pancetta on a lowish heat in a dry frying pan until crispy. When cooked, drain it and let it cool for a few minutes before adding it to the yolks, so the eggs do not cook. Add a pinch of rock-salt and a generous amount of ground pepper to the yolk mixture, then add the lemon zest, chopped thyme, and a small amount of Parmigiano cheese. Drain the pasta, count to 10 to let it cool slightly, and add it to the bowl. Mix it through with a wooden spoon, serve immediately, and sprinkle the remaining Parmigiano over the top.

cases.question: How do I make rice pudding without raisins?

response.answer: The Italian Rice Pudding recipe does not include raisins, so you can make it as written without any. To make it, bring 2 cups of water to a boil, add 1 cup of risotto rice, ¼ teaspoon of salt and 1 tablespoon of butter, cover, lower the heat to simmer and cook for 20 minutes. Place the rice in the upper part of a double boiler with 3 cups of half and half, 1 cup of granulated sugar, a cinnamon stick and a piece of lemon peel, bring to a boil over direct heat, then cook over simmering water for 45 minutes. Remove the cinnamon stick and lemon peel, pour the mixture into a 2-quart casserole to cool, and sprinkle with ground cinnamon. The ingredient list comes from the source page and may be incomplete.
